what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Pakistan, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 269472 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
UNHCR's file reports no internally displaced people for Pakistan in 2025; in UNHCR's data that can mean none, or none reported.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan from 2007 to 2025, at war level from 2008 to 2015 and in 2024 and 2025, with groups including the TTP and Lashkar-e-Islam.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in several periods since 2004, with groups including the BLA.
Floods, storms and earthquakes are the disasters recorded for Pakistan in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure peaked at 1900000 in 2014 and fell to 15890 by 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 and 2010 and 2014 and 2015, and the figure rose again between 2024 and 2025.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC recorded 3044740 new displacements from disasters, counted separately from conflict.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Pakistan people moved to.
